title: EntityBehaviorScreen
responsibility: The screen of a function or a service: opens on what its end-to-end checks recorded, with any recorded clip below.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.index
inputs.description: The harness history index the explorer reads. The source tab reads only its `sourceRepository`, a `https://github.com/owner/repo` URL that its file links are built from, and a value of any other shape gives no link.

revisions.subject: Show recorded end-to-end behavior on function pages
revisions.author: example-author

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the page is bound to. Its registry supplies the entity this screen opens, and its explanations give what the shown commit says it changed in that entity.

units.title: entityBehavior
units.responsibility: The headless results the host found for an entity, arranged for reading: one group for each state.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of the selected commit, or null at the branch tip and for a first commit. EntityFrame reads it only to show a unit the shown commit removed, as that unit's contract last was at the parent.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.scope
inputs.description: Where the page is in history: `commit` is the revision its results are bound to, `mode` is `current` when it follows the branch tip or `commit` when it stays on that commit, and `parent` is the commit a `commit` page compares it with, null for a commit with no parent. `atTip` is true when the shown commit is the tip, in either mode.

summary.subject: Show recorded end-to-end behavior on function pages
summary.author: example-author

summary.subject: Record end-to-end results for each function state
summary.author: example-author

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.route
inputs.description: The address shown: `category` and `entity` choose the unit that EntityFrame looks up, `helper` names a callable inside that unit, and `tab` names a tab other than the default. `commit` is null when the address names only a branch, which shows that branch at its tip.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.entities
inputs.description: The units of `head` as the explorer lists them, including the ones the shown commit removed. EntityFrame looks the routed entity up in this list before it reads the revision's registry.

examples.name: entityBehavior
examples.purpose: The headless results the host found for an entity, arranged for reading: one group for each state.

unit.title: entityBehavior
unit.responsibility: The headless results the host found for an entity, arranged for reading: one group for each state.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.lens
inputs.description: The host's readers for an entity: `evidence(unit)` and `behavior(unit)` give the captures and recorded end-to-end results shown here, `relations(id)` gives what an entity contains and what contains it, and `href(to)` builds its links. The screen works none of this out itself.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.client
inputs.description: The host's revision reader, exposed only as `revision(commit)`, which the type says is read only for commits a history lists. This screen's own markup never reads it; it reaches the children only inside `host`.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: The prefix each recorded media file name is appended to, which the harness sets to `/harness/media/`, so every retained capture, clip and archived source file is fetched from it.

inputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The host's navigation callback, which a link on this screen calls through `nav.go` with the destination `ExplorerLocation`. The host performs the navigation, and the screen itself changes no address.

outputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.endToEndOverview
outputs.description: The entity's frame and tab sections for a function, service or API: on the overview tab, its summary, its recorded end-to-end behavior (both sides at a commit that has a parent, otherwise one run) and any recorded audio. Other tabs show relations, permissions, tests, examples, source or contract instead of the overview, and a revision with no registry or an entity it does not hold shows a 'No registry at this revision' or 'Not at this revision' notice instead of the entity.
